blocks.body:
name = "acme/clock-bad-3"
version = "1.0.0"
[agent]
timeout = "30m"
network = "none"

[sandbox]
timezone = "America/New_York"
clock = { start = "2026-03-14T09:00:00-04:00", advance = "none", enforce = "preload" }

diagnostics.message: [sandbox] clock advance = "none" needs enforce = "world": a clock that stands still under preload or vm breaks sleeps and timers
